integrity: All mathematical claims follow from the stated exact 2x2 characteristic-polynomial factorization; checker tests symbolic identities and finite diagnostic cases only. Historical-priority comparison is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-patch linear growth, three fitness phases from two complementary states, fixed common contrast r>1, season-independent lossless direct exchange d in [0,1]. Does not infer stochastic persistence or evolutionary equilibrium; does not prove uniqueness of the above-threshold global optimizer.
title: A sharp discontinuous migration-benefit threshold in a binary three-season habitat cycle
